enriched_activities.desc: Lie on bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Stretch legs. Remain still. Wake up briefly. Turn over. Continue sleeping.

Wake up. Sit up on bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Pick up face wash. Apply face wash. Rinse face. Pick up towel. Dry face. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Walk into kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs. Take out milk. Close refrigerator. Open cabinet. Take out bowl. Crack eggs into bowl. Whisk eggs. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Pour oil into pan. Pour eggs into pan. Stir eggs. Turn off stove. Place eggs on plate. Open refrigerator. Take out butter. Spread butter on toast. Pour milk into glass. Sit at table. Eat breakfast. Drink milk. Stand up. Pick up plate. Walk to sink. Rinse plate. Place plate in dishwasher. Close dishwasher.

Walk into bedroom. Open closet. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Take out socks. Take out shoes. Close closet. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Walk to mirror. Comb hair. Pick up phone. Check phone. Pick up bag. Walk out of bedroom.

Walk out of house. Lock door. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Get off bus. Walk to workplace. Enter building. Greet colleague. Walk to office. Sit at desk. Turn on computer.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Open computer. Check emails. Read patient files. Answer phone. Talk to patient. Take notes. Walk to examination room. Wash hands. Put on gloves. Examine patient. Take blood pressure. Administer medication. Walk back to desk. Update patient records. Talk to colleague. Attend meeting. Drink water. Use computer.

Walk to cafeteria. Pick up tray. Select food. Pay for food. Find table. Sit down. Eat food. Drink water. Talk to colleague. Clear tray. Throw trash. Walk outside. Walk around building. Return to workplace. Sit down. Check phone.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Open computer. Review patient charts. Make phone calls. Consult with doctor. Walk to patient room. Check vital signs. Adjust IV drip. Administer injection. Talk to patient's family. Return to desk. Write reports. Attend training. Drink coffee. Use computer.

Walk out of workplace. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Get off bus. Walk to house. Unlock door. Enter house. Close door. Take off shoes. Hang up coat.

Walk into kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Take out chicken. Close refrigerator. Open cabinet. Take out pot. Place pot on stove. Turn on stove. Add oil. Add vegetables. Stir vegetables. Add chicken. Stir chicken. Add spices. Turn off stove. Place food on plate. Pour water into glass. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Stand up. Pick up plate. Walk to sink. Rinse plate. Place plate in dishwasher.

Pick up plates. Scrape food into trash. Rinse dishes. Load dishwasher. Add detergent. Close dishwasher. Turn on dishwasher. Wipe counter. Sweep floor. Take out trash. Replace trash bag. Wash hands. Turn off kitchen light. Walk out of kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing, watching TV and using computer
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into living room. Sit on couch. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Pick up laptop. Open laptop. Check email. Browse internet. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check social media. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Get snack. Walk back. Sit down. Watch TV. Turn off TV. Close laptop. Stand up. Walk to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Nighttime wash and preparing for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Pick up face wash. Apply face wash. Rinse face. Pick up towel. Dry face. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.
Lie on bed. Close eyes. Pull blanket. Adjust pillow. Turn over. Breathe slowly. Remain still. Wake up briefly. Turn over. Continue sleeping.
